name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Saves clicks that land a few ticks too early by holding them until the first tick where they would actually work. Also keeps press/release pairs in order.

buffer-enabled.name: Enabled
buffer-enabled.description: Turn the input buffer on or off. You can also flip this with the toggle keybind.

toggle-keybind.name: Toggle Keybind
toggle-keybind.description: Press to turn the buffer on/off at any time.

buffer-ticks.name: Buffer Window (ticks)
buffer-ticks.description: How many ticks early a click can be and still get saved. Anything earlier than this window is NOT saved. At 240 TPS, 1 tick is about 4.17 ms.

buffer-releases.name: Buffer Releases
buffer-releases.description: Keeps releases in order with their clicks: a release that arrives while its click is still waiting is replayed with the same hold length, and a release that lands in the same physics step as its press is held back one update so the press registers.
